target: sign(close[t+1] - close[t]); one full bar ahead; exact flat retained
flat_training: excluded from binary fitting; retained in calibration coverage and every evaluation
threshold_selection: per origin/model/asset; quantile of abs(2*p-1) on preceding calibration only; no labels used
ties: lexicographic confidence then SHA256(decision_time, symbol, fixed seed); no test ranking
coverage_test: observed, never forced to target by test quantiles
paired_controls: same emitted mask as model; controls also scored at full coverage

bootstrap.family: all 256 asset/horizon/model/coverage contrasts against each of 3 controls

new_interval.success: paired accuracy improvement over every registered control has simultaneous LCB > 0 in both bootstrap banks; adequate emitted sample/day counts; observed coverage disclosed; per cell, no pooled substitution

microstructure.clock: local receipt timestamp; decisions at minute boundary, events strictly before boundary
microstructure.split: first 60% train, next 20% calibration, final 20% test; purge 7 horizon bars on both training boundaries; overlapping labels are not independent

onchain.source: Glassnode; original data/code available from corresponding author on request
